audit: Stage 4B residual API, generation, persistence, and maintenance source audit

production_read_bracket.method: single serial loopback GET bracket; API bodies discarded except provider counters from the local subscription projection
production_read_bracket.provider_counter_scope: cumulative within listener process; before/after delta covers only this bracket
limits: One request per path; cache warmth and normal request variance were not controlled.
The process had 12 historical targeted config GETs at both endpoints; the bracket does not claim lifetime zero.
Response bodies and identifiers were discarded; only numeric metrics, status, duration, byte count, and route path were retained.

isolated_system_summary_profile.method: four uncached builds on a private SQLite online backup; enforcement, scoped runtime, and subject runtime-enforcement functions replaced by constants before the measured projections
limits: This measures local projections on a point-in-time private copy; it does not profile the live request or runtime enforcement work.
The 524 load_xray_bindings count is loader invocations only; whether the bindings file existed and whether those calls read or parsed it was not measured in this summary profile.
One live /system/summary sample took 1726.91 ms; its internal runtime/native/queue attribution remains unknown.

isolated_xray_generation_call_counts.method: two identical no-op candidate generations with a fake Xray adapter, fake local/native Mihomo validators, and temp-only files
isolated_xray_generation_call_counts.note: Invocation counts/order are evidenced; fake validators provide no native timing estimate.

scoped_egress_binding_gate_fix_ab.method: old source function from baseline 8d137b7 vs current function on the same isolated synthetic 315-subject projection fixture, four rounds; 131 explicit clients and a temporary 10,255-byte JSON binding file
limits: This is a bounded synthetic projection fixture, not the previous private full summary database fixture; its timing is micro-only and is not a live/full-summary latency claim.
The JSON binding file is temporary and isolated; no native runtime, provider, or production database calls are included.

isolated_maintenance_dispatch_counts.method: CLI dispatch with bootstrap/schema/maintenance functions replaced by counters, plus disabled startup-apply dispatcher with DNS reconcile replaced by a counter
isolated_maintenance_dispatch_counts.note: No real bootstrap, database, DNS, runtime, or maintenance operation executed.
